name: huang_passive_continuation_child
why: Corrected child of huang-h51fdd3-5. Retains BTC/SOL 15-minute probability-continuation signal qualification, hourly horizon, frozen parameters and risk budget, but replaces marketable entry limits with same-leg passive post-only bids after a through-ask refusal. Respects the real-entry price floor by abstaining, not raising bids. Starts at rung 0 and must qualify independently; sparse activity is not treated as permission to weaken the signal or risk controls.
